scope.supports: Kernel-checked (types in Type): for arbitrary A, B, E the old-image law r(u a) = inl a implies u injective, hence |A| <= |B| when finite; for arbitrary A, B and E = Unit every injective lift has a law-satisfying recovery r : B -> A + Unit (injective_iff_exists_law; with E empty the converse fails when A is empty and B is not); for injective u the law can be extended by any single value x : A + E at all off-image points (law_freedom_off_image; the independent free value at each off-image point is the content of law_card), so for an off-image point and an old term a0 there are two law-satisfying recoveries, one refusing and one accepting it (off_image_not_implied_general); for any lift u and recovery r, with A nonempty and two distinct observation values, there are observations q, q2 with q2 after u different from q (observation_not_implied_general; the law hypothesis is not used), while q := q2 after u preserves observations on the same lift (observation_preserved_possible), so observation preservation is an extra condition the law neither implies nor excludes; the identity lift satisfies the law while leaving every predicate on the old terms unchanged (repair_not_implied_general, a persistence statement for the identity lift only); for finite A, B and injective u the number of law-satisfying recoveries into A + Unit is (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) (law_card). The three source negative boundaries are fixed Fin instances and are reproduced as such. Native: exhaustive enumeration of all (u, r) pairs for eleven (|A|,|B|,|O|) cases with |A|,|B| <= 4: the number of law pairs, none with a non-injective lift, the number that refuse every off-image point (one per injective lift) and those that do not, observation pairs preserved, and obstruction pairs that persist or clear, all exact integers. Column definitions: persists = number of (law pair, oA, oB) with some a such that oA a and oB (u a); cleared = number with oA nonempty and no such a; these are counting conventions, not a repair notion. obs_preserved, persists and cleared are the law-pair count times a factor independent of r, so they carry no information about the law; the Lean statements carry that claim. The agreement of the producer enumeration with the checker closed forms is the independent evidence, not either alone.
scope.does_not_support: Off-image rejection as a property of the S(n) retraction (that is PG-SN-OFF-IMAGE-REFUSAL, which needs an added soundness hypothesis on r); the pinned SnCarrier lift and retraction; any definition of obstruction repair beyond persistence of a Boolean predicate through a lift (the source repair_not_implied instance uses the constant-true predicate and defines no repair); sets with more than four elements in the native census (the Lean count law_card is general for finite types); infinite types for the count; any physical or categorical reading.
scope.narrowest_claim: A recovery r : B -> A + Unit obeying r(u a) = inl a exists exactly when u is injective. For an injective lift it is determined only on the image: there are (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) of them, exactly one of which refuses every off-image point; when |A| >= 1 and |B| > |A| the others accept some off-image point as an old term, and for |B| = |A| or |A| = 0 the recovery is unique. The law fixes neither observations nor obstruction predicates (persistence through the identity lift only).
scope.next_test: Define repair of an obstruction for a lift (a witness-count or chain criterion on the lifted pair) and decide for the identity embedding and for a non-identity injective lift whether the old obstruction count strictly drops, replacing the constant-predicate instance of repair_not_implied by a statement with a stated repair criterion.
